description: This file contains utility functions related to proxy connection handling, including determining if an HTTP tunnel is required and creating SSL contexts for proxies. It defines functions that are likely used internally within the urllib3 library for managing proxy connections.

methods.name: connection_requires_http_tunnel( proxy_url=None, proxy_config=None, destination_scheme=None )
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP tunnel is required for the given proxy configuration and destination scheme.

methods.name: create_proxy_ssl_context( ssl_version, cert_reqs, ca_certs=None, ca_cert_dir=None, ca_cert_data=None )
methods.description: Creates a default SSL context for proxy connections, loading default certificates if necessary.
